selection_reason: ReasonAlloc is a training-free inference-time method that compresses reasoning-model KV caches by assigning nonuniform budgets across layers and dynamically across heads during autoregressive decoding. This directly targets serving memory and throughput constraints for long reasoning generations.
title: ReasonAlloc: Hierarchical Decoding-Time KV Cache Budget Allocation for Reasoning Models
